{{Youmay|the Hanging Gardens on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]|the [[hanging gardens]] on [[Hosnian Prime]]}}
The '''Hanging Gardens''' were located on the grounds of the [[Alaphoe Gardens]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. They were the centerpiece of the Alaphoe Gardens on [[Lalos Island]] and the pride and joy of [[House Cadriaan]]s [[High Lord|High Lady]] [[Bathos]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period.

The wooden trellises and flowerbeds contained numerous rare and delicate flowers from a hundred different worlds. The air was scented with the sweet fragrance of the flowers.
